dji_sdk_link_config.link_note: DJI Manifold 3 (M4E/4T, M4D/4TD, M400): USB bulk only, no UART. Build psdk_wrapper with -DPSDK_PLATFORM=manifold3. The Manifold 3 HAL (PSDK samples/sample_c++/platform/linux/manifold3/hal) uses fixed FunctionFS endpoints, the values below mirror it. In a box-* container pass through /dev/usb-ffs/bulk2 and /dev/usb-ffs/bulk3 (and bulk6 for perception/media) with --functionfs, plus --network host.
